study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input replication of source 6a5e62a8…: maximum tokenizer mean over 32 frozen pairs under the exact stable-v2 comparator, population, roster, aggregation, interval and ordered equal-weight no-undo/can-undo settlement strata.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated routing still offers the exact Lemony source for token_delta replication with no matching open attempt
the source manifest remains recoverable and its comparison identity, estimand contract, member-span interval, and two ordered settlement strata are copied exactly
all 32 complete pairs and individual arms have zero overlap with every valid historical token manifest on the proposal
each form has eight reports and eight instructions; can-undo has four each of path-only, window, holder, and cost slots
every careful-English arm carries the same action and reversibility content as its marked arm under the pinned shortest comparator genre
tiktoken loads only after mint and direct counts, the SDK helper, and the write-boundary verifier agree
every finite supportive, null, or adverse result files exactly once without result-based retry

manifest.selection: Thirty-two wholly new prewritten action sentences across 32 domains, balanced by form and report/instruction shape; can-undo also balances four how-slot types. Frozen before tokenizer exposure.
manifest.method: After mint, count marker minus the pinned shortest careful-English comparator with tiktoken 0.14.0; report every member, the least-favourable maximum, member span, and both equal-weight source strata.
manifest.scope: Current token cost only; not whether an undo path works, restores all state, remains authorized, or improves comprehension or safety.
